source:
England, in the year 2118. Theo is in his final year of 6th form college when he literally bumps into fellow student Connor Erichssen on the corridor. Having avoided touch for so long Theo feels that something is odd but can't quite figure out what. An attraction is sparked between the two from this one meeting and Theo tries to understand why he is so drawn to him.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210801231850/https://supercircuit.itch.io/2112]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2118年的英国。西奥正在读六年级学院最后一年，在走廊上与同学康纳·埃里克森迎面相撞。西奥一直避免身体接触，觉得这次相撞有些不对劲，却说不出原因。仅仅一次相遇，两人之间便萌生了吸引力，西奥试图理解自己为何如此被他吸引。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210801231850/https://supercircuit.itch.io/2112]itch.io[/url]]
